role.heading: How will you use Propfolio?
role.subtitle: This tailors your home screen and tools. You can adjust it later in settings.

OWNER.title: Owner
OWNER.desc: I own property and want oversight — reporting, planning, and hands-off management.

OWNER_MANAGER.title: Owner + Manager
OWNER_MANAGER.desc: I own and self-manage — I want owner insights plus the full day-to-day management toolkit.

MANAGER.title: Manager / Régie
MANAGER.desc: I manage property on behalf of owners — leases, finance, requests, and contractors.

profile.heading: Tell us who you are
profile.subtitle: Basic identity details so we can set up your account and documents correctly. Formal verification (ID / company registry) isn't required yet.
profile.tos: I agree to the Terms of Service and confirm the information above is accurate.

property.heading: Add your first property
property.subtitle: Start with one building — you can add the rest anytime. Import lets us hydrate units, tenants and finances from your régie's year-end package.
property.dropHint: Drop the year-end package — a régie PDF, or CSVs (balance sheet, income statement, rent roll, general ledger)
property.nothingCreated: Nothing is created yet. We'll analyze it while you answer a few quick questions next.

status.retry: Analysis will be retried at the next step.

property.multiYearHint: One PDF per year — add several to import multiple years.

risk.heading: A few questions about your goals
risk.subtitle: This builds your investor profile so recommendations fit how you actually think about your property.
risk.importError: We couldn't analyze the package — you can retry later from Properties
risk.importSomeFailed: ({{count}} couldn't be read — retry later from the building)

connections.heading: Bring in your team
connections.subtitle: Invite the manager or régie who handles day-to-day operations. They'll get access to your buildings.
connections.importedBody: You'll be able to invite them to the tenant app (to see leases, invoices and send requests) from the building's Tenants tab.

preferences.heading: Make it yours
preferences.subtitle: Set your defaults — you can fine-tune everything (including per building) later in settings.
preferences.overdueRemindersDesc: Automatically remind tenants when rent is late.
preferences.ownerReportDesc: Email a portfolio summary at the start of each month.
preferences.autoRouteMaintenanceDesc: Send new maintenance requests to your preferred contractors.

done.heading: You're all set!
done.setUpImporting: is set up and your package is importing.
done.fallback: We'll take you to your dashboard and show you around.
